item.headline: Welcome
item.content:
Hello, 

Welcome to CSC 1060 1H1 Computer Science I: Java

This is a hybrid class combining lecture session and lab session into a single class meeting session once a week. 

Students MUST attend this class session meetings. If a student cannot make class session meetings, the student should drop this class and enroll in an online class instead.  

For the first class meeting I will NOT be lecturing directly from the Textbooks.

The required Textbook is 

Pearson eText for Introduction to Java Programming and Data Structures (Pearson+)

By  y. liang
Edition : 13TH 24
Publisher : PEARSON+
ISBN 13 : 8220145135180
    
The recommended/optional Textbook is below, BUT the course content has ebook links or references to the previous version in Library's Oreily ebook link

Java: How to Program, Early Objects (Paperback)

By  deitel, paul
Edition : 11TH 18
Publisher : PEARSON
ISBN 13 : 9780134743356

item.headline: Hello
item.content:
Hello

Hello, 

I am Michael your instructor.

I am a part-time instructor. I work in the Information Technology field as a Middleware Engineer provide server level Enterprise Java support.

For the first class meeting I will be providing information about the course and computer science department.      

You will NOT need to have purchased your book before class, I will be talking about software, programs and program development. 

Later!

item.headline: Information Request
item.content:
Information Request

Hello!

The PPSC CIS and CSC departments are part of an network called NCWIT - our hope is to increase enrollment in our departments as well as retention.  For this, we need student input.  Please take 10 to 15 minutes to do the following survey:  CSC Course Feedback Survey

If you could do it by Thursday, 10 September, that would be great as we have a meeting on the 11th but please do no later than Friday, 18 September.

Thank you for participating!

Monica Novack (CSC Department Chair/Professor)
